company_name.description: The full legal name of the company presenting

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, including the exchange if stated, e.g. 'NYSE American: PRK'

fiscal_period.description: The fiscal period the presentation covers, e.g. 'Q4 2025'

as_of_date.description: The as-of date for the financial figures, as YYYY-MM-DD

headquarters.description: City and state of the company headquarters

total_assets.description: Total assets as stated, including units, e.g. '$9.8 billion'

business_description.description: One sentence describing what the company does

fee_income.description: Fee income detail from the 'Diverse Fee Income' slide

fee_income_business_lines.description: The business lines responsible for generating the majority of fee income, as listed in the overview bullets

non_interest_income_to_operating_revenue.description: Non-interest income to operating revenue ratio for the most recent full year, as stated in the bullets, e.g. '21.5%'

assets_under_management.description: Aggregate assets under management of the wealth management business line, as stated in the bullets, including units

net_interest_income_latest_year.description: Net interest income for the most recent year in the Non-Interest Income / Operating Revenue bar chart, in millions, as a number

non_interest_income_latest_year.description: Non-interest income for the most recent year in the bar chart, in millions, as a number

revenue_by_year.description: Net interest income, non-interest income and their ratio for each year in the bar chart

non_interest_income_to_operating_revenue.description: The ratio plotted above the bars, as a number, e.g. 21.5

largest_income_source.description: The largest single source in the Sources of Non-Interest Income pie chart, by name

largest_income_source_percent.description: The percentage held by the largest source in the pie chart, as a number

income_sources.description: Every slice of the Sources of Non-Interest Income pie chart

source.description: The income source name, e.g. 'Fiduciary Activities'

share_percent.description: Share of non-interest income as a number, e.g. 38

aum_basis_footnote.description: The footnote explaining the basis on which assets under management are stated

pension_settlement_gain.description: The pension settlement gain figure mentioned in the footnotes, including units

debt_securities_loss.description: The loss on sale of debt securities mentioned in the footnotes, including units and the year it relates to
